# Typeform — Typeform startup program

75% off Typeform's Business plan for one year, available only on a yearly plan, for seed-stage startups that are not already Typeform customers.

### Notes

VENDOR SELF-CONTRADICTION on eligibility. The Help Center article (cited as official_source) states: "Your startup must be at a seed stage. Your startup must have less than $1 million in funding. Your startup must have less than $1 million in lifetime revenue. Your startup must not be an existing Typeform customer." The marketing landing page at https://www.typeform.com/typeform-startups states a DIFFERENT and looser set in its FAQ: "Not already be a paying Typeform customer / Less then $5M in funding / Less then 50 employees / Less then 5 years old". Per the conservative rule, funding_max_usd and revenue_max_usd are taken from the Help Center ($1,000,000 each); employees_max (50) and company_age_max_years (5) appear ONLY on the landing page and are recorded with that caveat. Full terms and conditions live behind https://admin.typeform.com/to/dwk6gt, which was not opened.
